measurement_context: 34 orthodontic patients; repeat digital-model measurement using maxillary palatal ROI; same operator

what_it_supports: Within-workflow remeasurement precision can be quantified at submillimeter scale
limits_for_trauma_restoration: Orthodontic model; not trauma; crown surface and maxillary palate only; same operator; excludes scan/reposition error; derived MDC95 is analysis-only

measurement_context: 40 adult Wistar rats; 900 cN subluxation impact then 50 cN induced movement at day 1 or 3; histology after 7-day movement
reported_precision_or_agreement: No 3D pretreatment/follow-up pose precision; post-impact movement groups showed no better histologic periodontal repair than movement-only comparator
what_it_supports: Directly tests force application after retained-tooth impact; cautions that movement is not itself evidence of improved repair
limits_for_trauma_restoration: Five animals per group; does not measure return to pretreatment pose, load-bearing function, or long-term durability
use_in_this_plan: Do not use as evidence that movement restores original position or regenerates attachment; add pose and post-support endpoints

measurement_context: Immature rat intrusive luxation; 20 N model with micro-CT/histology at 3 to 90 days; spontaneous re-eruption observed
reported_precision_or_agreement: No validated serial pose measurement error reported in the source summary; positional change and tissue outcomes were tracked
what_it_supports: Candidate distinct model for true in-socket displacement and apical/periodontal outcomes
limits_for_trauma_restoration: Immature teeth and severe intrusion; re-eruption does not establish native PDL mechanics; pulp changes, ankylosis, and replacement resorption reported
use_in_this_plan: Candidate model only; quantify position separately from attachment and do not pool with subluxation
